key_insight: SSF-Net combines spatial and spectral processing to learn local interactions and global PDE coupling with near-linear asymptotic complexity in spatial token count.
engineering_relevance: SSF-Net offers a potential surrogate for repeated FEM-based PDE predictions, though solid-mechanics-specific validation is not established in the abstract.
method: Multi-directional Mamba captures local interactions while reducing directional scanning bias.
Fourier processing with a block-diagonal MLP captures global spectral features efficiently.
A multiresolution convolutional encoder-decoder integrates spatial-spectral fusion blocks across scales.
evidence_signal: Across a multi-task PDE benchmark with long-horizon stability assessment, SSF-Net reports lower prediction error and fewer parameters than attention- and convolution-based baselines.
watch_item: Accuracy on complex solid-mechanics geometries, boundary conditions, and nonlinear material behavior requires separate validation.
paper_title: SSF-Net: A Spatial-Spectral Fusion Network for Accurate PDE Operator Learning
